name: RoboBugBench
summary: Evaluates automated repair of 33 real defects in a ROS 2 navigation stack, grading patches through behaviour in physics simulation, and audits the grading rule against counterfeit patches.
numbers: 3 frontier models repair 24.2–36.4%; shipped rule accepts counterfeit patches 11 of 11

why.dex: No motor skill; the robot runs the patched stack.
why.xr: Agents changing robot software while a grader misses suppressed failures; nearest entry to self-modification.
